caveats: Synthetic circular frustum, homogeneous neo-Hookean tissue, fixed inner core and rigid socket.
Quasi-static load progress is not physical time.
Primary profile refines mesh and penalty, but full mesh/contact convergence remains unproven.
Stored positive contact gap is penetration; zero can mean released contact, not apposition.
P95 is an area-weighted empirical quantile over evaluated lateral surface, not a clinical safety limit.
Primary interpolation domain is 0 to 0.5 percent radial growth; extrapolation forbidden.
Growth proxy uses healthy cross-sectional age9-10 ratios, not measured residual-limb longitudinal growth.
Uniform 0.10mm enlargement is assumed CAD design comparison; actual clinical adjustment feasibility is unknown.
Reactions use xplt vector reaction forces. Legacy Rx/Ry/Rz text outputs are unusable zeros.

relative_motion.definition: Tissue surface nodal displacement minus rigid socket transform evaluated at the same reference surface coordinates; mean axial component.
relative_motion.classification: Kinematic proxy from actual FEBio outputs
